Title: ServiceNow Change Request List: Building AND Filters
Description: Step-by-step workflow to construct a multi-condition AND filter on the Change Request list page.
- Open the filter panel by clicking the 'Show / hide filter' button (bid a47) to reveal filter inputs.
- Select the first field (e.g., 'Type') from the combobox labeled 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --' (bid a1181).
- Set the value for the selected field by clicking the value chooser combobox (e.g., 'Choose option for field: Type') and selecting the specific option (e.g., 'Normal').
- Add the next condition by clicking the 'Add AND Condition To Condition X: [Field] is [Value]' button (e.g., bid a1303, a1781, a2257).
- For the new condition, select the required field from its field chooser combobox.
- For text fields, fill the value textbox directly (e.g., 'Requested by' textbox bid a2118).
- For empty string checks, select the 'is empty string' option from the operator combobox.
- Repeat the add-condition step until all required fields (State, Short description) are configured.
- Recorded workflow clarification (intent, not verified execution): Workflow clarification: verify the required field before proceeding to the next form field.
